name: Air-to-Air Missile
author: Machine
description: Experimental air-to-air missile (PL-15). The missile is a real flyable pseudo-aircraft rebuilt from its .planedesign file (game part prefabs + procedural fuselage), not a static model. Combat cargo: weight 10, cargo space 60, stored in the Combat Hold (BattleHold) with a large-font counter on the HUD. Launched with a hotkey and flown to the target by an in-house proportional-navigation AI autopilot with raycast terrain/obstacle avoidance (probe fan + ridge profile + AGL floor, so it no longer flies into mountains). AI entities never trigger voice alerts. Depends on BattleHold.
